description: This file defines data models, query parameters, and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing Federal Reserve Primary Dealer Fails data, including data transformation and API request handling.

classes.name: FederalReservePrimaryDealerFailsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching primary dealer fails data, including asset class and unit options.

classes.name: FederalReservePrimaryDealerFailsData
classes.description: Represents individual data entries for primary dealer fails, including title and value.

classes.name: FederalReservePrimaryDealerFailsFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching, transformation, and API requests for primary dealer fails data.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a strongly-typed query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from the Federal Reserve API, handling different time periods and data structures.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into structured data objects, applying filters based on query parameters.
